fields.System.Title: INB-301 — Generate putaway tasks on receipt confirm
fields.System.Description:
Story

As a putaway operator, I want work to appear automatically when a receipt is confirmed,
so that stock does not sit on the dock waiting for someone to create a job.

Acceptance criteria

  • - Given a receipt confirms, then one putaway task exists per received line, in the same
  • transaction as the stock creation.
  • - Given the receipt transaction rolls back, then no putaway tasks exist.
  • - Given a task, then it records product, batch, quantity, and source receiving location.
  • - Given quarantined quantity on a line, then its putaway task targets the quarantine
  • area, not general storage.
  • - Given the tasks, then they are unassigned and available to any qualified operator.

Traceability

| Aspect | Detail |
|---|---|
| Modules | inbound |
| Tables | putaway_task |
| Risks | Tasks created before commit, referencing stock that does not exist ([doc 04 §3.4](../../../docs/04-modules.md)) |
| Tests | integration · rollback |
